canvas.$description: Background of an unselected radio control.

canvas-checked-hover.$description: Control background when selected and hovered.

canvas-checked-active.$description: Control background when selected and pressed.

canvas-checked-disabled.$description: Control background when selected and disabled.

border-color.$description: Border color of an unselected radio control.

border-color-checked-hover.$description: Control border color when selected and hovered.

border-color-checked-active.$description: Control border color when selected and pressed.

border-color-checked-disabled.$description: Control border color when selected and disabled.

border-width.$description: Border thickness of the radio control.

border-style.$description: Border style of the radio control.

border-radius.$description: Corner radius of the radio control (a circle by default).

indicator-canvas-checked-hover.$description: Indicator surface background when selected and hovered.

indicator-canvas-checked-active.$description: Indicator surface background when selected and pressed.

indicator-canvas-checked-disabled.$description: Indicator surface background when selected and disabled.

indicator-ink.$description: Slotted indicator content color when unselected.

indicator-ink-hover.$description: Slotted indicator content color when hovered.

indicator-ink-active.$description: Slotted indicator content color while pressed.

indicator-ink-checked.$description: Slotted indicator content color when selected.

indicator-ink-checked-hover.$description: Slotted indicator content color when selected and hovered.

indicator-ink-checked-active.$description: Slotted indicator content color when selected and pressed.

indicator-ink-checked-disabled.$description: Slotted indicator content color when selected and disabled.

indicator-ink-disabled.$description: Slotted indicator content color when disabled.

indicator-border-color-checked-hover.$description: Indicator border color when selected and hovered.

indicator-border-color-checked-active.$description: Indicator border color when selected and pressed.

indicator-border-color-checked-disabled.$description: Indicator border color when selected and disabled.

indicator-border-width.$description: Indicator border thickness; zero preserves the standard dot.

indicator-size.$description: Diameter of the selection dot and size of slotted indicator content; em-based so size variants rescale it through font-size.

indicator-radius.$description: Corner radius of the selection dot (a circle by default).

indicator-box-shadow-checked-hover.$description: Indicator shadow when selected and hovered.

indicator-box-shadow-checked-active.$description: Indicator shadow when selected and pressed.

indicator-box-shadow-checked-disabled.$description: Indicator shadow when selected and disabled.

indicator-box-shadow-focus.$description: Indicator shadow when the native radio has keyboard focus.

indicator-transform.$description: Indicator transform when unselected; scale(0) hides the standard dot.

indicator-transform-hover.$description: Indicator transform when an unselected radio is hovered.

indicator-transform-active.$description: Indicator transform while an unselected radio is pressed.

indicator-transform-checked.$description: Indicator transform when selected; scale(1) reveals the standard dot.

indicator-transform-checked-hover.$description: Indicator transform when selected and hovered.

indicator-transform-checked-active.$description: Indicator transform when selected and pressed.

indicator-transform-checked-disabled.$description: Indicator transform when selected and disabled.

indicator-transform-focus.$description: Indicator transform when an unselected radio has keyboard focus.

indicator-transform-disabled.$description: Indicator transform when an unselected radio is disabled.

indicator-transition-duration.$description: Duration for indicator surface state transitions.

indicator-transition-timing-function.$description: Easing for indicator surface state transitions.

indicator-transition-property.$description: Indicator surface properties that animate on state changes.

indicator-transition-delay.$description: Delay before indicator surface transitions run.

font-family.$description: Font family for the radio label.

font-size.$description: Font size for the radio label.

font-weight.$description: Font weight for the radio label.

line-height.$description: Line height for the radio label.

letter-spacing.$description: Letter spacing for the radio label.

gap.$description: Space between the control and its label.

align-items.$description: Cross-axis alignment of control and label.

group-direction.$description: Flow direction of a .zbk-radio-group (column or row).

box-shadow-checked-hover.$description: Control shadow when selected and hovered.

box-shadow-checked-active.$description: Control shadow when selected and pressed.

box-shadow-checked-disabled.$description: Control shadow when selected and disabled.

box-shadow-focus.$description: Control shadow in the focus state (in addition to the outline).

cursor.$description: Cursor when hovering an enabled radio.

cursor-disabled.$description: Cursor when hovering a disabled radio.

transition-property.$value: background-color, border-color, box-shadow, transform, opacity, outline
transition-property.$description: CSS properties that animate on state changes.
